scope: All FSTRES94 dispatcher branches within the finite initialized and bounded allocation domain. This is an import/storage review, not verification of constitutive evaluation.
reviewed_contracts: All sixteen positive mode branches, zero, signed negative including INT_MIN, and unknown positive modes match the retained dispatch order and selected destinations.
Material selection and creation precede outer int3; failure preserves FSTRES state while earlier creation persists. FSTRES has no post-payload refresh.
All ten table constructors and all forty-two coefficient doubles plus three integer fields are represented once. Named coefficients at 0x368 have no duplicate scalar storage.
Type 0xa6 owns one zero axis and two dependent values at initialization; 0xa7 and 0xa8 own one zero dependent value even though rank0/width1 payload reading does nothing. Type0x51 defers allocation.
Mode9 runs both seven-real helpers and uses the second status. Mode10 consumes seven outputs but stores six. Mode14 reads its table even after coefficient failure and uses the table status.
Modes2/3,7/8 and16 perform their final flag stores after payload failure, but not after an earlier count/width helper failure.
Mode6 local-header failures preserve the corresponding prior table; first payload failure prevents the second header. Modes13/15 stop between independently owned linked tables.

Modes13/15 derive integer sum and product from axis0 in ascending order, not dependent data. Native CVTTSD2SI/ADD/IMUL are reproduced for representable finite conversion and non-overflowing intermediate extents; out-of-domain cases throw explicitly.
Seven-real parsing zero-initializes all destinations, replaces commas, keeps partial assignments, and returns failure only on fgets EOF or scan -1. Replay emits all seven outputs.
Property payload direct matching failures retain initialized values; rank2/3 scratch matching failures are explicitly unsupported. EOF keeps direct mutations and does not commit incomplete scratch.
limitations: No native execution or original comparison was performed by this review; capture verification is pending.
Native signed32 overflow in derived extents and out-of-range floating conversion are intentionally outside the bounded API domain, although machine behavior is documented in the byte audit.
Allocation failure, nonfinite conversion, unknown native padding, arbitrary external aliases and the stress-law scientific consumers are not reconstructed by this review.
Native temporary-buffer leaks on failed payloads are not reproduced as C++ ownership leaks; imported values and status remain the comparison target.
